why: Shares published with no two integers in the same artifact that reproduce them, as of this gate's first run. FROZEN means RECORDED, not forgiven: each is a rate a reader cannot check. R883 measured 1788 of 3014 (59.3%) unauditable across 417 artifacts.
how_they_survived: Three wrong denominators reached commit this session and none was caught by review -- each was caught by a later round that happened to recompute the same thing. The necessary condition they all failed is not 'was the denominator right' but 'was it written down at all'.
lower_bound_note: A coincidental n/d pair can satisfy the proxy, which inflates the AUDITABLE side. So this count is a LOWER bound on the problem, not an upper one.
